settings.binary.label: Helper binary
settings.binary.description: The sonyctl executable that talks to the headphones.
settings.address.label: Bluetooth address
settings.address.description: Pin a specific device MAC. Leave empty to auto-discover the paired Sony device.
settings.name_filter.label: Name filter
settings.name_filter.description: Only auto-discover devices whose name contains this text (optional).
settings.channel.label: RFCOMM channel
settings.channel.description: Bluetooth serial channel. Leave empty to resolve it automatically via SDP.
settings.state_dir.label: State directory
settings.state_dir.description: Where the daemon writes status.json and its control socket.
settings.bluetoothctl_binary.label: bluetoothctl path
settings.bluetoothctl_binary.description: Used to discover the paired device.
settings.sdptool_binary.label: sdptool path
settings.sdptool_binary.description: Used to resolve the RFCOMM channel via SDP.
settings.keep_alive.label: Keep connection alive
settings.keep_alive.description: Stay connected for live battery. Turn off to release the control channel for the Sony phone app when idle.
settings.idle_timeout.label: Idle timeout (seconds)
settings.idle_timeout.description: When keep-alive is off, disconnect after this many seconds without a command.
settings.refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
settings.refresh_seconds.description: How often the daemon re-reads state and the widget re-reads the status file.
